providers.reason: Direct beneficiary of Germany's infrastructure/defense spending super-cycle (€82.7B defense 2026, rising to €109B in 2027). Trading near 52-week low €155.50 after 16% 12-month decline, creating value recovery opportunity. Analyst targets €214-232 represent 30-40% upside. Raised 2026 outlook.
providers.risk: ECB rate decision could pressure cyclicals; surging oil prices increasing energy/input costs for building materials sector.

providers.reason: RBC upgraded to Outperform (€211 target) naming Heidelberg among preferred building-materials names, and Jefferies keeps Buy/€286 with ~4.6% Q3 organic growth expected. At roughly €143 the stock trades far below both targets, leaving room to catch up ahead of the Nov 4 trading update.
providers.risk: No company-specific catalyst falls inside the 2–5 day window; weak European construction demand, weather-hit Q3 volumes and rising yields can keep the stock drifting.
